name: Omatek Ventures Plc
source: CRON 20261014: Omatek Ventures Plc unaudited consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the period ended 30 June 2026, Group January to June 2026 column (NGX doclib filing library), printed in N millions and scaled to naira. Revenue 1.00 less the printed cost of sales 0.20 equals the printed gross profit 0.80. Gross profit less the printed administration expenses 32.23 equals the printed loss from operating activities 31.43, which is also the printed loss before tax and the printed loss for the period because the filing charged no tax and reports no finance cost. Basic loss per share stored in naira from the printed 0.004 loss. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | blank split cells computed from the file's own stored totals (Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales; the current/non-current split sums to the total) | CRON 20261002: Net Profit filled for FY2025 and FY2024 from the Omatek Ventures Plc consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 December 2025, page 18, printed in millions of naira. Printed loss on continuing operations (62.96) for 2025 and (86.33) for 2024; profit attributable to the group (58.92) and (79.35). Ties: the stored Profit before tax of (49.78) and (73.15) less the stored tax expense of 13.18 and 13.19 equals (62.96) and (86.33). The statement prints no finance cost or finance income for either year, so Net Finance Costs stays empty rather than zero.
